svg.aria-label: Pooled cat and dog maps feed two hidden units, the horizontal and vertical centre-of-mass gaps; these give five logits and probabilities. Identical maps give 0.2 on every class. One step of size 5 gives left of a probability of 0.7961.
svg.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: The head turns two maps into a relation
Two hidden units measure how far apart the maps' centres of mass sit. Their weights are the patch positions.
After one push of step size 5
The cat's mass has moved left and the dog's right, so Δu = -0.6221.
The chance of "left of" rises from 0.2 to 0.7961, and the loss falls to 0.2280.
